name: mera-news
description: News picked for what you follow, from thousands of publishers in many languages. Mera Labs keeps no copy of your interests.
long_description: Mera News reads the news for you and picks the stories that matter to what you follow. Tell your assistant about your work, your city or the stories you care about. Those facts are kept in a small database on your computer, never with Mera Labs. The news comes from Mera News, with reports of one event grouped into one story and a link to every publisher. Search the news, get the latest from a country, and read each story on the publisher's own site. It reads from a news server you run yourself (set its address in "News server address"), or from Mera News with a key you ask for at https://mera.news/en/api-key.

api_key.title: News key
api_key.description: For Mera News: a key from the form at https://mera.news/en/api-key (test key, 2,000 requests a day, for your own use). For your own news server: the key you set on it, or nothing if it runs open.

data_server_url.title: News server address
data_server_url.description: Leave empty to use Mera News. To use a news server you run yourself, give its address, such as http://127.0.0.1:3002. Mera Labs then needs no key from you.

web.title: Also run the Mera News website on this computer
web.description: Shows your news, top stories and profile in your browser, on this computer, and on your phone if you connect it.

tools.name: get_suggestions
tools.description: Stories picked for the facts you follow.

tools.name: news_for_profile
tools.description: Every story that matches the topics of your facts, a page at a time.

tools.name: rate_stories
tools.description: Save your assistant's verdict on each story: picked or left out, with a reason.

tools.name: top_stories
tools.description: The top stories for the world or a country, with every publisher's link.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: The latest news, from a country or the topics you follow.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search the news by words or meaning.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: The facts saved about you, each with its news topics.

tools.name: add_facts
tools.description: Save facts about you, such as your city or your work, with their news topics.

tools.name: remove_facts
tools.description: Remove saved facts and their topics.

tools.name: edit_topics
tools.description: Remove a news topic, or show more or less of it.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Whether reading is on, when your digest is due, and anything that needs fixing.

tools.name: set_reading
tools.description: Pause or resume reading, change how often it reads, or set when you want your digest.

tools.name: open_news_site
tools.description: Open your Mera News website on this computer.
